stories.title: Food help remains one of the clearest signs of household strain
stories.summary: Official USDA FNS research page for SNAP household characteristic reports.
stories.reader_headline: Food help remains one of the clearest signs of household strain
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from SNAP Household Characteristics, SNAP Data Tables, USDA ERS Food Price Outlook is a baseline for tracking whether food pressure is broadening.
stories.what_happened: SNAP data helps show whether food assistance remains a major support for households under grocery pressure.
stories.potential_relevance: This signal may show up later as tighter grocery tradeoffs, higher pantry demand, and less room in monthly budgets.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Families with low or fixed incomes, households with children, and older adults.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch whether food assistance reliance and grocery cost pressure are rising or easing.

stories.title: Bankruptcy filings help show where debt stress is breaking through
stories.summary: Official bankruptcy filings baseline including chapter and business/nonbusiness splits.
publisher_names: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
stories.reader_headline: Bankruptcy filings help show where debt stress is breaking through
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from U.S. Courts Bankruptcy Filings Statistics, U.S. Courts Caseload Data Tables helps anchor whether debt stress may be moving from warning signs to hard outcomes.
stories.what_happened: Bankruptcy filings are a delayed but concrete sign that households or businesses have run out of easier options.
stories.potential_relevance: This signal can show where debt stress could break into missed payments, service disruption, or local job risk.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Heavily indebted households, small businesses, and workers tied to stressed employers.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch for spillover into layoffs, service disruptions, and local business closures.

stories.title: Housing costs are still the budget pressure that can crowd out everything else
stories.summary: Shelter inflation baseline for rent and housing-linked household cost pressure.
stories.reader_headline: Housing costs are still the budget pressure that can crowd out everything else
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from BLS CPI Shelter Index is a baseline for whether housing and bill pressure remains persistent.
stories.what_happened: Shelter inflation baseline for rent and housing-linked household cost pressure.
stories.potential_relevance: This is a baseline for watching whether housing and utility costs keep crowding out other essentials.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Renters, first-time buyers, and households already cost-burdened on monthly bills.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch whether shelter and utility pressure is broadening or stabilizing.

stories.title: Health coverage data helps show who may be exposed if access changes
stories.summary: National and state Medicaid/CHIP enrollment baseline.
publisher_names: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
stories.reader_headline: Health coverage data helps show who may be exposed if access changes
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from Medicaid and CHIP Enrollment Data helps track whether coverage and access pressure could widen.
stories.what_happened: National and state Medicaid/CHIP enrollment baseline.
stories.potential_relevance: This signal may matter if households could face coverage gaps, delayed care, or higher out-of-pocket pressure.
stories.who_may_feel_it: People with chronic conditions, caregivers, and uninsured or underinsured households.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch for coverage changes, closures, and access bottlenecks.

stories.title: Jobs and paychecks remain the first line of defense against household pressure
stories.summary: Official labor market baseline for unemployment and job losses.
stories.reader_headline: Jobs and paychecks remain the first line of defense against household pressure
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from BLS Employment Situation helps show whether job and paycheck stability is holding.
stories.what_happened: Official labor market baseline for unemployment and job losses.
stories.potential_relevance: This is a signal of whether paycheck stability can still absorb rising costs.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Hourly workers, workers in cyclical sectors, and households with small savings buffers.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch layoffs, unemployment direction, and paycheck resilience.

stories.title: Weather and climate conditions can turn into cost pressure
publisher_names: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
National Drought Mitigation Center and USDA and NOAA
stories.reader_headline: Weather and climate conditions can turn into cost pressure
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from NOAA NCEI Monthly Climate Reports, U.S. Drought Monitor provides baseline evidence for this pressure area.
stories.potential_relevance: This can show up later as food, energy, insurance, and repair cost pressure.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Rural communities, outdoor workers, and households in climate-vulnerable regions.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch whether drought and weather pressures spill into food, housing, and health stress.

stories.title: Disaster declarations show where local systems may be stretched
stories.summary: Federal declarations baseline for local system strain events.
stories.reader_headline: Disaster declarations show where local systems may be stretched
stories.data_context_summary: Data context from FEMA Disaster Declarations provides baseline evidence for this pressure area.
stories.what_happened: Federal declarations baseline for local system strain events.
stories.potential_relevance: This signal may indicate where local systems could have less buffer if conditions worsen.
stories.who_may_feel_it: Commuters, caregivers, students, and households relying on local services.
stories.what_to_watch_next: Watch for cuts, local budget strain, and recurring infrastructure disruptions.
